title: Marketing VA for real estate
description:
Remote Marketing Virtual Assistant (UK Property Sales & Overseas Investor Engagement)



Part-Time Freelance | 25–30 hours/week | Flexible schedule across UK & SE Asia time zones



About Us



We are a growing UK-based estate and lettings agency with offices in Greater Manchester. We support local homeowners, landlords, and tenants as well as a growing base of international investors. As new legislation such as the UK Renters Rights Bill creates movement in the property sector, we are seizing the opportunity to match landlord-exit properties with overseas buyers and retain these properties under our fully managed service.





We are actively expanding into new UK territories and investing in international investor relationships. One Director is based in Jakarta and regularly travels to cities such as Singapore, KL, Bangkok, and Hong Kong to meet potential buyers. Our UK-based Director manages on-the-ground delivery. We're now hiring a Remote Marketing VA to support both local marketing delivery and structured investor lead generation.





Your Role: What You'll Do



This role is split into two major focus areas:





1. Local Marketing Support (Greater Manchester & Yorkshire Focus)



- Post scheduled content (property listings, sold prices, video walkthroughs) 3x/week



- Create and format leaflets and mailers for local distribution



- Maintain and refresh local market updates and insights from trusted sources (e.g. Rightmove, Property Industry Eye)



- Engage with local renters and buyers on
 and Instagram



- Support reporting on post performance and local lead engagement





2. SE Asia Investor Lead Generation & Sourcing Support



- Build and manage lead lists of prospective investors in Singapore, KL, Jakarta, Hong Kong, and Bangkok



- Promote our 1% sourcing fee model to targeted investor groups



- Schedule regionally aligned content (Tues/Thurs) to support Director's travel and lead-in campaigns



- Support micro-campaigns in advance of in-person investor visits



- Help match investor leads to local properties, including off-market or churned landlord stock



- Prepare investment summaries or property packs as needed





Key Tools You'll Use



- Canva, Google Workspace, Mailchimp / ActiveCampaign



- LinkedIn,
, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok



- CRM tools (Pipedrive, HubSpot or similar)



- Hootsuite / Buffer for scheduling





Performance & Incentives



- Competitive hourly rate (DOE)



- Commission and bonuses based on:



- Verified investor leads



- Properties sourced and sold via our model



- Lead volume growth



- Social media engagement and list expansion





Who We're Looking For



Required:



- 2+ years digital marketing / social media experience



- Excellent written English and persuasive copywriting ability



- Proactive and self-managing, with strong attention to detail





Preferred:



- Experience marketing to non-native English speaking investors preferred



- Bilingual fluency in English and any SE Asian language (Mandarin, Bahasa, Malay, Thai) is a strong advantage



- Experience with UK property or investment marketing



- Familiarity with SE Asian investor communities, education networks, or financial planning norms



- Basic SEO knowledge or content repurposing for multiple formats





Working Structure



- 25–30 hours per week



- Flexible working hours to allow collaboration with:



- UK-based Director (compliance, delivery)



- SE Asia-based Director (investor growth, outreach)



- Weekly planning call required





To Apply



Send your CV, a short cover letter, and 1–2 examples of your work (social posts, campaigns, or marketing assets)

title: Ops Coordinator and Sales VA
description:
Operations Coordinator & Sales Support VA 

Location 

Remote (Philippines) 

Hours 

Full Time 

Working hours are flexible, provided the successful candidate can maintain regular communication with the UK team and ensure all daily responsibilities are completed. The role is designed to take advantage of the time difference between the Philippines and the UK, allowing planning and preparation work to be completed before the UK business day begins. 

About Us 

We are a growing UK property business operating multiple offices across the North West of England. Our services include residential lettings, property management and residential sales. 

We believe in building systems, processes and long term relationships. We are not looking for someone to simply complete tasks. We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership, solving problems and helping a business run efficiently. 

Unlike many remote opportunities, you will be joining a business that already has an established Virtual Assistant team and proven systems in place. We have extensive experience working successfully with remote tea
mbers and have developed clear processes, training materials and support structures to help new tea
mbers succeed. 

About the Role 

We are looking for an intelligent, organised and proactive Virtual Assistant to join our team. 

Property experience is helpful but not essential. Full training will be provided. We are more interested in attitude, communication skills, attention to detail and the ability to learn quickly than previous estate agency experience. 

The primary purpose of this role is to coordinate the diaries of our field based property team. Your job is to ensure appointments are booked efficiently, routes are planned effectively and our team can spend their time carrying out appointments rather than organising them. 

Alongside this, you will support our sales team through lead follow up, campaign administration and general CRM management. 

This position would suit someone who enjoys organising people, managing schedules, improving processes and ensuring that nothing falls through the cracks. 

Primary Responsibilities 

Field Operations Coordination (Main Focus) 

This is the most important part of the role. 

You will be responsible for helping our field based property team work as efficiently as possible. 

Diary Management 

 Schedule and coordinate: Property management visits 

 Inventories 

 Check outs 

 

 Manage appointment calendars 

 Ensure diaries remain fully utilised 

 Minimise travel time through effective route planning 

 Reorganise schedules when cancellations occur 

 Identify diary gaps and work proactively to fill them 



Tenant and Landlord Communication 

• Contact tenants to arrange appointments 

• Confirm appointments and access arrangements 

• Follow up unanswered messages 

• Rebook cancelled appointments 

• Resolve scheduling issues where possible 



Workflow Coordination 

• Maintain accurate records within company systems 

• Track outstanding appointments and follow up actions 

• Ensure completed appointments are recorded correctly 

• Escalate issues requiring management attention 

• Monitor workflow progress and ensure tasks do not become delayed 



Daily Planning 

• Prepare schedules in advance wherever possible 

• Ensure field staff begin each day with a clear and organised schedule 

• Plan future appointments efficiently and proactively 



Sales Support Responsibilities 

Alongside operational coordination, you will support our sales team with lead management and administration. 

Lead Management 

• Follow up property enquiries 





• Contact prospective clients 

• Arrange appointments for valuation calls and meetings 

• Maintain accurate CRM records 

• Ensure no lead is forgotten or left without follow up 



Marketing Campaigns 

• Assist with customer follow up campaigns 

• Send scheduled communications to existing and prospective clients 

• Support lead nurturing activities 

• Maintain campaign tracking records 



Sales Administration 

• Assist with Anti Money Laundering (AML) administration 

• Issue sales documentation and terms of business 

• Support customer onboarding processes 

• Maintain accurate records and documentation 



Essential Skills 

We are looking for someone who can demonstrate: 

• Excellent written and spoken English 

• Strong organisational skills 

• High attention to detail 

• Confidence using software and online systems 

• Ability to learn new processes quickly 

• Strong problem solving skills 

• Ability to manage multiple priorities 

• Ability to work independently 

• Professional and confident communication skills 

• Reliable internet connection and suitable home working environment 



Desirable Skills 

The following would be helpful but are not essential: 

• Previous Virtual Assistant experience 

• Experience supporting a UK business 

• Appointment scheduling experience 

• CRM experience 

• Customer service experience 

• Sales administration experience 

• Property industry experience 



Full training will be provided for the right candidate. 

Personal Attributes 

The successful candidate will be: 

• Highly organised 

• Proactive 

• Reliable 

• Process driven 

• Calm under pressure 

• Customer focused 

• Positive and professional 

• Comfortable taking ownership of tasks 

• Keen to learn and develop 



Working With Our Team 

You will be joining an established remote team and will not be working in isolation. 

We already have experienced Virtual Assistants supporting different areas of the business and have well developed systems, processes and training in place. The successful candidate will receive structured onboarding and ongoing support while learning the role. 

We have extensive experience working successfully with remote tea
mbers and understand the importance of clear communication, realistic expectations and effective training. 

We believe in building long term relationships with our tea
mbers. As the business continues to grow through acquisition and expansion, there will be opportunities for increased responsibility and career progression for the right person. 

Performance Expectations 

Success in this role will be measured by: 

• Efficient scheduling of appointments 

• High diary utilisation for field staff 

• Reduction in travel time and diary gaps 

• Prompt follow up of enquiries and leads 

• Accurate record keeping 

• Strong communication with tenants, landlords and colleagues 

• Consistent completion of administrative tasks 

• Contribution to the overall efficiency and growth of the business 



What We Offer 

• Full training 

• Long term opportunity within a growing business 





• Structured systems and processes 

• Support from an experienced remote team 

• Clear expectations and responsibilities 

• Remote working environment 

• Opportunity to grow with the business as additional offices are acquired 



This role is ideal for a bright, organised and hardworking individual who enjoys creating order, solving problems and helping a business run efficiently. Previous property experience is welcome but not required. We are looking for attitude, capability and potential above all else. 

If you are highly organised, enjoy coordinating people and processes, and want to build a long term career with a growing business, we would love to hear from you

This role is not for a general customer support agent.



We need someone who deeply understands the full PayPal dispute process, knows how to handle every type of dispute situation, and has a proven track record of achieving a high win rate.



Most importantly, we need someone who can create, organize, and implement the right dispute workflows and SOPs to help us win more PayPal disputes, win subscription-related disputes, and prevent unnecessary PayPal disputes from happening in the first place.

Subscription Dispute Experience Required

We have subscription-based products, and subscription disputes can come from many different scenarios. We need someone who already understands these situations and knows how to prepare the best evidence, response strategy, workflow, and SOP for each case.

* Customer communication history

* Delivery and tracking proof

* Account activity or subscription history

* What evidence to collect

* How to prevent similar disputes

* How customer service should respond before it becomes a dispute

* When to refund

* When to fight

* When to escalate

* How to protect the PayPal account from future risk

title: CREATIVE STRATEGIST WITH MEDIA BUYING EXPERTISE (eCommerce / Dropshipping)
description:
CREATIVE STRATEGIST WITH MEDIA BUYING EXPERTISE (eCommerce / Dropshipping)



We're a multi-brand eCommerce company scaling across the German, French, and US markets. We're looking for a Creative Strategist who lives and breathes direct-response advertising, someone who can engineer winning ads, understand exactly how they perform inside the ad account, and keep producing fresh angles that move revenue.



This is not a "make pretty content" role. If you bring fresh ideas, proven results, and the ability to perform under pressure, keep reading.





SKILLS WE NEED



1. Winning Ad Research & Reverse-Engineering

   You can dig through spy tools, find ads that are clearly winning, and break down exactly WHY they work. More importantly, you can take that winning angle and build a brand-new original script from it that we can own.



2. Direct-Response Script Writing

   You write scripts for image ads, video ads, advertorial pages, and product pages that sell. You understand hooks, angles, emotional triggers, and problem-solution frameworks, not just clever wording.



3. Multi-Market Creative Strategy

   You can write for German, French, and US audiences and make each one feel native. You understand that an angle that crushes in the US might flop in Germany, and you adjust accordingly.



4. Creative-to-Performance Analysis

   You don't just create ads, you read how they perform. You can look at the numbers and know whether the problem is the ad, the offer, the landing page, the audience, or the product.



5. Offer & Angle Development

   You constantly generate new angles, hooks, concepts, and offers. You don't run dry after three ideas.



6. Working Under Pressure

   You make fast, data-driven decisions when revenue is on the line and you don't fold when performance drops.



7. Full Funnel Understanding

   You understand the entire Shopify dropshipping process, from the ad, to the product page, to checkout, so your creatives align with the whole buyer journey.





TOOLS WE USE (AND THAT YOU SHOULD KNOW)



Spy & Research Tools

   - Gethookd (must be expert level)

   - Kalodata (must be expert level)

   - Plus any similar ad spy and winning-product research tools you bring to the table



Advertising & Analytics

   - Meta Business Suite / Meta Ads Manager (for reading campaign performance)



Store & Funnel

   - Shopify (core platform for our stores and product pages)



Collaboration & Briefing

   - Tools for writing creative briefs and coordinating with editors and designers (Google Workspace, Slack, ClickUp, or similar)



If you're an expert in Gethookd and Kalodata specifically, you move to the top of the list. If you bring other strong spy tools we don't use yet, even better. We want someone who improves our stack, not just fits into it.





JOB SCOPE (WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO)



1. Research & Intelligence

   Use spy tools daily to find winning ads and products, study why they work, and feed that intel into our creative pipeline.



2. Script & Concept Creation

   Write scripts for image ads, video ads, advertorials, and product pages across the German, French, and US markets.



3. Angle Development

   Take winning ads, reverse-engineer the angle, and turn them into fresh, original concepts we can run as our own.



4. Performance Review

   Work alongside our media buyers, review ad performance, and identify which creatives to kill, improve, or scale.



5. Troubleshooting & Turnarounds

   When a product or campaign is underperforming, diagnose the real cause and propose new creative angles, offers, or page improvements to turn it around.



6. Briefing the Team

   Write clear, detailed creative briefs for our video editors and graphic designers so execution matches your strategy.



7. Bringing New Strategies

   Continuously introduce fresh techniques, testing ideas, and creative strategies that keep us ahead of competitors.





WHAT YOU MUST BRING



   - A proven track record with real results and achievements you can show us, not just talk about

   - Expert-level skill with spy tools, especially Gethookd and Kalodata

   - Expert script writing for image ads, video ads, advertorials, and product pages

   - The ability to analyze a winning ad's angle and build a fresh script from it

   - Extensive experience writing scripts for German, French, and US audiences

   - A solid understanding of the full Shopify dropshipping business process

   - The ability to handle pressure and make fast, data-driven decisions

   - Strong direct-response instincts and a deep grasp of customer psychology





NICE TO HAVE



   - Hands-on Meta Ads media buying experience

   - Experience turning around declining products or campaigns

   - UGC, podcast ad, and native ad scripting experience





THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF



You think in angles and hooks, not just visuals. You get excited reverse-engineering a competitor's winner. You can write for three very different markets and make each one feel native. And when performance drops, you don't panic, you diagnose.



If that's you, apply and show us your best work.

title: SHOPIFY & GEMPAGES EXPERT / ECOMMERCE FUNNEL BUILDER
description:
SHOPIFY & GEMPAGES EXPERT / ECOMMERCE FUNNEL BUILDER



Every winning ad we run leads somewhere, and that somewhere is the page YOU build. We can have the best creatives in the market, but if the product page is slow, broken, or sloppy, the sale dies on arrival. That's why this role matters as much as it does.



We're hiring a Shopify & GemPages Expert who treats page building like a craft: pixel-accurate duplications, scripts followed to the letter, every app wired up correctly, and zero broken links by the time it reaches us. If you're the kind of builder who can't sleep knowing a button might be misaligned, you're exactly who we want.





SKILLS WE NEED



1. Shopify & GemPages Page Building

   You can build product pages, landing pages, advertorials, and full funnel pages inside GemPages. This is your core craft, not something you've dabbled in.



2. Accurate Page & Store Duplication

   You can take any page we show you and duplicate it precisely, across different Shopify stores, without breaking structure or losing detail.



3. Script-Exact Execution

   You follow provided scripts exactly. You place translated text correctly, keep the structure intact, and don't "improve" things we didn't ask you to change.



4. Funnel & Offer Setup

   You know how to set up post-purchase upsells, downsells, bundles, subscriptions, and digital files (ebooks) so the full funnel works end to end.



5. Shopify App Configuration

   You can install and configure the apps that power our funnels, correctly the first time.



6. Quality Assurance & Attention to Detail

   You catch broken links, missing text, untranslated copy, misplaced images, and mobile issues before they ever reach us. Nothing ships half-done.



7. Multi-Market Building

   You've built for German, French, and US audiences and know how to handle translated content properly within each store.



8. Fast Execution

   You work quickly without sacrificing quality, and you take ownership of a task from start to finish.





TOOLS WE USE (AND THAT YOU SHOULD KNOW)



Core Platform

   - Shopify (store setup, theme customization, policy pages)

   - GemPages (must be expert level, this is the heart of the role)



Upsells, Bundles & Subscriptions

   - OCU for post-purchase upsells and downsells

   - Kaching Bundles for bundle offers

   - Kaching Subscriptions for subscription offers



Digital Products

   - Fileflare (or similar) for ebooks and digital file delivery



Supporting Apps

   - Review apps

   - Tracking apps

   - Page builder apps

   - Upsell / cross-sell apps

   - Conversion optimization apps



Collaboration

   - Tools for coordinating with management, creative strategists, media buyers, and ops (Google Workspace, Slack, ClickUp, or similar)



If you're already fluent in OCU, Fileflare, Kaching Bundles, and Kaching Subscriptions specifically, you move to the top of the list.





JOB SCOPE (WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO)



1. Build Pages

   Create product pages, landing pages, advertorials, and funnel pages in GemPages based on the scripts and designs we provide.



2. Duplicate Pages & Stores

   Replicate pages we show you and copy internal pages across different Shopify stores accurately.



3. Place Translated Content

   Build pages for German, French, and US audiences, placing translated text exactly where it belongs based on the provided script.



4. Set Up Offers

   Configure post-purchase upsells and downsells (OCU), bundles (Kaching Bundles), subscriptions (Kaching Subscriptions), and digital files (Fileflare).



5. Configure Apps & Policy Pages

   Install and set up required Shopify apps, plus all policy and support pages: Privacy, Return, Refund, Shipping, Terms, Subscription Policy, Contact, and FAQ.



6. Quality-Check Everything

   Before submitting, verify every link, button, image, text, translation, and integration works, on both mobile and desktop, across the full customer journey.



7. Work With The Team

   Coordinate closely with management, creative strategists, media buyers, and the operations team to keep builds aligned and on time.





QUALITY ASSURANCE STANDARD (NON-NEGOTIABLE)



Before any task is submitted, you must confirm:

   - All links are correct and all buttons work

   - All images are placed correctly, none misplaced

   - No text is missing and nothing is left untranslated

   - All sections are properly aligned

   - Both mobile and desktop versions work

   - All apps are properly integrated

   - All upsells, downsells, bundles, and subscriptions work

   - All digital files / ebooks are properly connected

   - All policy pages are correctly set up

   - The full customer journey works from start to finish





WHAT YOU MUST BRING



   - Extensive, expert-level Shopify experience (not basic)

   - Extensive, expert-level GemPages experience

   - Proven, accurate page and store duplication skills

   - Hands-on experience with OCU, Fileflare, Kaching Bundles, and Kaching Subscriptions

   - Experience building for German, French, and US ecommerce stores

   - A strong, reliable quality-control process

   - The ability to follow scripts exactly and work fast without dropping quality

   - Strong ownership, communication, and attention to detail





THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF



You're a Shopify and GemPages expert who can duplicate any page accurately, follow a script to the letter, set up every app correctly, and check everything before submitting. You work fast, you're obsessive about detail, and you take ownership of the final result.





THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF



You only have basic Shopify experience, you're not strong in GemPages, you can't duplicate pages accurately, you skip the QA step, or you submit unfinished work. If you're not detail-oriented, this isn't the role for you.





TO APPLY



Please send:

   - A short introduction about yourself

   - Your Shopify experience

   - Your GemPages experience

   - Ecommerce or dropshipping brands you've worked with

   - Examples of Shopify pages you've built

   - Examples of pages you've duplicated

   - Shopify apps you have experience with

   - Your experience with OCU, Fileflare, Kaching Bundles, and Kaching Subscriptions

   - Your experience with German, French, and US ecommerce stores

   - Your availability

   - Your expected monthly rate





SCREENING QUESTIONS



1. How many years of Shopify experience do you have?

2. How many years of GemPages experience do you have?

3. Have you duplicated Shopify or GemPages pages before? Please provide examples.

4. Have you worked with German, French, or US ecommerce audiences before?

5. Are you comfortable following a provided script exactly when building a page?

6. What Shopify apps do you have the most experience with?

7. Have you set up post-purchase upsells and downsells using OCU before?

8. Have you set up bundle offers using Kaching Bundles before?

9. Have you set up subscriptions using Kaching Subscriptions before?

10. Have you set up ebooks or digital files using Fileflare or similar apps before?

11. What is your quality control process before submitting a completed page?

12. How do you make sure all links, buttons, translations, images, and integrations are working correctly?





At Aurum LLC, the pages you build are where our ad spend turns into revenue. If you're the right person for this role, we encourage you to apply.

title: HubSpot CRM & AI Automation Specialist
description:
We’re looking for someone to build, optimize, and maintain our HubSpot CRM while helping us create an AI-driven sales management system.



The goal is to eliminate as much time as possible spent inside HubSpot without sacrificing visibility or organization.



For example, we’d like to interact with our CRM using natural language:



* “What are my priorities today?”

* “What follow-ups are due?”

* “Which deals are stalled?”

* “Who hasn’t responded in over a week?”

* “What is Jose supposed to work on today?”

* “Summarize my pipeline.”

* “Draft follow-up
s for today’s tasks.”



HubSpot should remain the source of truth, but we’d like AI to become the primary interface for reviewing sales activity, managing priorities, and making decisions.



This role will also include keeping HubSpot organized by maintaining contacts, companies, deals, tasks, notes, automations, and reporting.



Application Questions



Rather than telling you exactly how we want this built, we’d like you to tell us how you would build it.



Please answer the following:



* How would you approach this project?

* Is this the right architecture, or would you recommend something different?

* How would you connect HubSpot with ChatGPT, Claude, or another AI platform?

* Would you recommend AI only reads HubSpot, or should it also be able to update records?

* How would you ensure the system remains reliable and doesn’t become a maintenance headache?

* What parts of HubSpot should remain manual?

* What parts should be automated?

* What tools, integrations, or APIs would you use?

* Have you built anything similar? If so, please describe it.



We’re looking for someone who can think through the entire system, recommend the best approach, build it, and continue improving it over time—not someone who simply manages CRM records.

Important:

- Set up ClickUp from scratch across all departments: workflows, dashboards, automations, task structures

- Make sure all work is captured in the system - nothing managed informally or lost in chat

- Coordinate between Creative and Operations teams so projects move smoothly

- Document existing business processes into clear, usable SOPs

- Handle day-to-day approvals within defined boundaries, escalating only real issues to the founders

- Lead weekly/monthly KPI reviews and quarterly planning sessions

- Run the weekly tea
eting - status updates, blockers, decisions - focused and on time

- Translate founders' quarterly objectives into clear team and individual goals

- Monitor performance, spot problems early, and drive corrective action

- Build and manage the product-launch workflow based on the existing 15-step launch process

- Spot what's slowing the team down and fix it - don't just flag it

- Keep an eye on profitability alongside the founders

- Onboard new hires: set up tools, assign SOPs, guide their first weeks



Tools You Must Know:

- ClickUp - expert level, you've built systems from scratch before

- Google Sheets / Excel - KPI dashboards, reporting

- Slack or similar - team communication

- Amazon Seller Central - you don't need to be a specialist, but you need to understand the context

- Zoom - weekly meetings with owner and team



Who We're Looking For:

We're looking for someone who's been in the trenches of ecommerce operations - not someone who's managed tasks, but someone who's built systems and led people.



- 3+ years in operations or team management in an ecommerce or Amazon environment

- You've built SOPs from scratch and know how to make processes that people actually follow

- You've set up ClickUp or similar tools for a team starting from zero

- You know how to keep a remote team aligned and accountable - without being on their back every hour

- You're comfortable with numbers - KPIs, margins, performance tracking

- Excellent English, written and verbal

- Familiarity with Amazon tools

- You're looking for somewhere to grow long-term, not just another contract



Compensation & Setup:

- $1,200–$1,600+/month based on experience

- Full-time, 40h/week

- 14 days paid leave after 3 months

- First 3 months: time-tracked via Time Doctor as part of our standard onboarding process

- Long-term position - We Invest in People Who Invest in Us



What Success Looks Like

- Within 1 month: ClickUp is fully adopted, the weekly rhythm is running, and the founders' approval load has dropped significantly

- Within 3 months: KPIs are tracked and reviewed consistently; the team works to clear quarterly goals

- Within 6 months: the company runs smoothly day-to-day without the founders being involved in every decision



To Apply - Required

Answer these 4 questions. Applications without answers will not be considered:



1. Describe a project management system you built from scratch (ClickUp, Asana, Monday, or similar) — what was the situation, how did you structure it, and what changed after? Only apply if you have actually done this. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you did.

2. How do you hold a remote team accountable without micromanaging? Give a real example from one of the companies listed in your CV: include the team size, what tool you used, and what happened when someone missed a deadline. Do not describe what you would do — describe what you actually did.

3. You join BTS Brands on Monday. By Friday you need to send the founders your first weekly summary. What's in it and how did you get that information in 5 days?

4. What project management tools have you used, and rate your confidence in each from 1 to 10. For the tool you rated highest - what's one thing you can do in it that most people don't know about?

title: AI UGC Video Creator / Creative Designer (Supplements & Problem-Solving Products)
description:
AI UGC Video Creator / Video Editor / Creative Designer (Supplements & Problem-Solving Products)



We are looking for a full-time AI UGC Video Creator / Video Editor / Creative Designer to join our e-commerce team immediately.



This role is perfect for someone who understands AI video creation, UGC-style ads, supplement and health products, Meta/Facebook advertising, and realistic customer-style testimonial videos.



We are not just looking for a basic video editor. We are looking for a creative person who can take a product image, create a realistic person or model, build a strong UGC-style video concept, write or improve the script, add voiceover, and deliver polished ad creatives that are ready to run on
, Instagram, TikTok, and other platforms.



## What You Will Create



You will create daily ad creatives for supplements, wellness, and problem-solving products, including:



- AI-generated UGC-style videos

- Realistic customer testimonial-style videos

- Problem and solution videos (show the problem, then the product as the answer)

- Before/after style result videos

- Product unboxing videos

- "My daily routine" videos (someone using the product in their morning or night routine)

- Mirror selfie / talking-to-camera videos

- Voiceover ads

- Product highlight videos for supplements, capsules, gummies, powders, drinks, skincare, and other health or problem-solving products

- Short-form ads for Meta, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and
 Ads



### Example video concepts:



- A person receives a parcel, opens it, shows the supplement, and talks about why they ordered it and what problem they wanted to fix.

- A 45+ person talks about how they struggled with low energy (or sleep, joints, bloating, focus, hair, skin, etc.) and how this product helped.

- A simple "3 reasons I take this every day" talking video with text on screen.

- A customer-style UGC video where the person talks about how easy the product is to use, how it tastes or feels, and why it fits into a busy day.

- A "problem ? solution ? result" video that hooks the viewer in the first 3 seconds with a relatable problem.



## Tools You Should Know



You should have experience using AI tools such as:



- Seedance

- Kling AI

- Higgsfield

- Nano Banana / Nano Banana Pro

- ChatGPT

- HeyGen

- Runway

- Google Veo

- ElevenLabs

- CapCut

- Canva

- Premiere Pro

- Photoshop or similar tools



You do not need to use every tool, but you must be confident creating realistic AI videos and improving them with editing, voiceover, captions, music, and strong ad structure.



## Main Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



- Turning product images into realistic lifestyle images and videos

- Creating realistic AI people/models using or talking about our products

- Writing or improving UGC scripts and hooks built around a clear problem and solution

- Creating natural voiceovers and customer-style dialogue that sounds real, not scripted

- Editing videos with captions, music, transitions, product close-ups, and strong hooks

- Making creatives that feel real, natural, and not overly AI-generated

- Creating ads designed to stop scrolling and drive clicks, sales, and conversions

- Testing different angles for supplements and problem-solving products

- Following platform rules around health and supplement claims (no fake or extreme "cure" promises)

- Working quickly and delivering creatives daily

- Taking feedback and improving creatives based on performance



## What We Are Looking For



We want someone who can think like a creative strategist, not just a video editor.



You should be able to look at a product and suggest strong ad angles such as:



- "The natural way to fix [problem]"

- "What I wish I knew sooner"

- "I tried everything before this"

- "My honest 30-day results"

- "Energy after 40/50"

- "The 10-second part of my morning routine"

- "If you struggle with [sleep / bloating / focus / joints], watch this"

- "Doctor-formulated and easy to take"

- "Simple daily habit that changed everything"

- "Customer try-it-yourself style"



The goal is not just to make beautiful videos. The goal is to create ads that help generate sales.



## Editing Skills We Look For



- **Pacing:** Fast-paced editing and fast at revisions

- **Visual Hooks:** Strong use of text overlays, B-roll, and sound effects

- **Direct Response Focus:** Understands different styles of creatives (AI, UGC, compilation, etc.)

- **Iteration Speed:** Able to quickly test new concepts



## Requirements



You must have:



- Experience creating UGC-style video ads

- Experience creating videos for supplements, health, wellness, beauty, or problem-solving products

- Experience with AI video generation tools

- Strong video editing skills

- Good understanding of Meta/Facebook ad creatives

- A good eye for realism, lighting, colors, and clean product presentation

- Ability to create realistic human/model videos using AI

- Ability to write or improve hooks, scripts, and voiceovers

- An understanding of advertising rules for health and supplement products

- Strong attention to detail

- Fast delivery and reliable communication

- A creative mindset and willingness to test new ideas



## Work Style



This is a full-time remote position with an **immediate start**.



We are looking for someone long-term who can grow with our supplement and wellness brands. You must be available daily, work quickly, and be comfortable receiving feedback.



You should be excited about AI, health and wellness products, video creation, and direct-response advertising.



## Bonus Structure



In addition to your monthly salary, we offer monthly performance bonuses based on how well your creatives perform.



If your videos help create winning ads, strong sales, and profitable campaigns, you will be rewarded with extra bonuses.



## To Apply



Please send:



- A short introduction about yourself

- Your portfolio or links to AI/UGC video ads you created

- Examples of supplement, health, beauty, or e-commerce ad creatives you have made

- The AI tools and editing software you use

- Your experience with
/Meta ad creatives

- Your monthly full-time rate

- Your availability and when you can start



**Please start your application with the word ICANDOIT so we know you read the full job post.**



## Test Task



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to create FREE sample creatives using our product images. This will help us understand your creativity, AI video quality, editing skills, and ability to create realistic UGC-style ads for supplements and problem-solving products.



We are actively hiring and ready to onboard the right person immediately.

Marketing Manager (Remote, Full-Time, Long-Term)

Schedule: Mon–Fri, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Philippine Time (1 hr break)

Compensation: Starts with a paid part-time trial, moving to full-time once successful

Why You'll Love This Role

We're a fast-growing Australian group of businesses in the entertainment and technology space, and we're scaling fast, opening new physical venues and launching a brand-new B2B tech arm. We're looking for one creative, data-driven marketer to own our marketing end-to-end and grow with us into a leadership role as we build out a full team. If you want real ownership (not just executing someone else's plan) and a stable, long-term home, this is it.



What You'll Own & Execute

This is a hands-on role, you'll create the ideas and ship them. You'll have full ownership of our marketing calendar, campaigns, and brand voice across both our entertainment venues and our B2B tech software. Your mission: drive inbound leads for the tech arm and get feet through the door at our venues.



Paid Advertising: build, monitor, and optimize Meta & Google Ads campaigns.

Video Production: concept, script, and edit engaging short-form video.

Graphic Design: create social posts and static ad assets (Canva or similar).

Campaign Planning: brainstorm promos, plan launches, and execute start to finish.

UGC Management: recruit and manage creators to build a social-proof library.

Retention Marketing: build and schedule
 & SMS campaigns.



Day-to-Day Rhythm

Daily: publish 1 organic short-form video.

Weekly: ship 1 high-converting marketing
 + a performance report.





What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

A predictable marketing engine: social channels alive with fresh daily content, paid ads running efficiently within budget, and leadership with full clarity on which channels drive revenue, thanks to your weekly reports.



Who You Are

- 3+ years as a Marketing Manager, Senior Content Creator, or Growth Marketer.

- Experience in both B2C (hospitality, retail, or entertainment) and B2B (tech/SaaS).

- Skilled with modern tools: CapCut/Premiere, Canva, Meta Business Suite, Google Ads, Mailchimp/Klaviyo.

- Strong copywriter with excellent written + spoken English.

- Data-driven: your creative calls are backed by the numbers.

- Self-directed, organized, and able to juggle multiple projects.



The Opportunity

Stable, long-term, full-time remote role with genuine room to grow, build and lead a marketing team as the business scales, working directly with the CEO.



How to Apply (please include all 5, incomplete applications won't be reviewed)

1. A short 1–2 min video introducing yourself and why you're a great fit. (Required, this is how we know you're a real applicant)

2. Your updated CV.

3. A portfolio link showing past campaigns, graphics, and short-form videos you personally edited.

4. The budget question: If we gave you $5,000 for the month, how would you split it across channels (Meta, TikTok, Google,
, etc.) for the entertainment business vs. the B2B tech business? Give a quick breakdown + why.

5. Your expected monthly salary (AUD or PHP).

title: Senior Lifestyle Manager for an AI company

asures themselves against. Someone who has done this work at a senior level, knows what great looks like from the inside, and is ready to build something.

We run an AI-native lifestyle management platform for the world's most demanding clients — founders, athletes, family offices, and high-net-worth individuals who expect their personal and professional lives to run without friction.

* Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (EST)

Core Responsibilities



Member Experience

* Triage and manage a high-volume live queue across dining, experiences, wellness, and luxury goods simultaneously, at a pace.

* Elevate confirmed plans before members ask. Personal touches, upgraded access, and proactive picks that show you actually know them.

* Make outbound calls to hotels, restaurants, and venues globally to secure what others can't, and build the relationships that make that repeatable.

* Communicate with members and partners with precision and warmth. Right detail, right tone, right 
nt.

* Use our Claude-powered AI platform to research and build offers fast, applying your own judgment before anything reaches a member.

* Document every preference, interaction, and partner note so the next person picking up a request knows exactly where things stand.



Team Leadership

* Own the quality bar for everything the team sends out and hold it without being asked.

* Onboard and upskill incoming Lifestyle Managers, transferring your instincts and standards to the people behind you.

* Review work, give direct feedback, and flag problems to leadership before they become issues.



You're Perfect for This Role If You

* Have led or mentored a team before, formally or not, and understand what it means to be accountable for someone else's output.

* Notice what members need before they say it, not through research, but through the pattern recognition that comes from years of real client proximity.

* Have worked in high-volume, high-pressure environments where everything is urgent and you recalibrate rather than freeze.

We are an AI-powered lifestyle management platform built for the world’s highest-performance founders, athletes, and family offices. This is a role with a real growth path. If you want to grow into a leadership position, not just do a job, strong performers here will be the first in line to step up as the team scales.



What This Role Actually Looks Like

Here’s a concrete example. A member is flying to New York for three days. Their itinerary: check in to the Four Seasons, dinner at Nobu, a visit to the Met.

A good assistant books those things. You do something different.



You call the Four Seasons’ guest relations team, build a quick rapport, and arrange for two bottles of Dom Pérignon to be waiting in the room with a handwritten welcome card from the company.

Nobu is fully booked. You find the right contact, introduce yourself professionally, and get the table anyway - because you know how to talk to people who matter.

You reach out to the Met’s private tours team and arrange for a dedicated art historian to personally guide the member through the galleries, with refreshments waiting.



That’s the standard. Every member, every trip.

PTO, Wellbeing Stipend, Growth path into a leadership role

* Make outbound calls to hotels, restaurants, venues, and luxury service providers in the US, UK, and beyond. Representing the company with confidence and professionalism on every call.

* Document member preferences, request history, and partner interactions in our systems every time, without being reminded.

* Grow into a leadership position as the department scales. Strong performers will take on increasing ownership of the Lifestyle Manager function.



You’re Perfect for This Role If You

*Have 3+ years in a high-touch, client-facing role serving wealthy or high-profile principals - whether as a personal or executive assistant to a CEO, a VIP or guest relations manager at a five-star location (e.g. The Peninsula Manila, Shangri-La, Solaire, Raffles), or a client relations manager at a luxury brand (e.g. LVMH, Richemont, Rustan’s).

*Speak and write English at a native level. Clear, confident, and polished whether you’re messaging a member or calling a hotel manager in New York or London.

*Have a phone manner that gets results and you’re not rattled by gatekeepers, you know who to ask for, and “fully booked” is never where the conversation ends.

We need someone who:



* provides updates without being chased

* explains technical issues clearly

* flags problems early

* asks clear questions when needed

* gives realistic timelines

* does not hide blockers

* documents what has been changed

* can explain the commercial reason behind technical work

* detail-oriented

* reliable

* proactive

* analytical

* commercially minded

* able to work independently

* clear in communication

* focused on measurable results

* comfortable giving daily updates

* willing to take ownership of outcomes

**TECHNICAL SEO RECOVERY - MARINE**

title: Voiceover Artist — True Crime YouTube Documentary
description:
I am looking for a voiceover artist for a narrated true crime documentary YouTube channel. Videos are 50–55 minutes long and published 2 times per week.

This is ongoing work — if the first video goes well, I will continue hiring you for every video going forward.

The voice I am looking for:



Calm, measured, and authoritative — investigative documentary tone

Deep and clear — easy to listen to for 50+ minutes

Natural delivery — not dramatic, not news anchor style, not audiobook performance

Comfortable with serious subject matter — this is real criminal case content



The reference for the tone and style I need is JCS Criminal Psychology on YouTube. Please listen to at least one video before applying so you understand exactly what I am looking for.

For each video I will provide:



A fully written script broken into 5 acts

Clear pronunciation guides for all names

Pacing and delivery notes throughout the script



What I need from you:



Record each act as a separate audio file

Deliver as high quality MP3 or WAV

Raw recording only — no music, no reverb, no effects added

Turnaround of 2–3 days per script



To apply please send a voice sample of yourself doing documentary or narration style recording. Do not send singing samples or commercial samples — I need to hear your narration voice specifically. Applications without a voice sample will not be considered.

 and LinkedIn prospecting skills

title: Carrier Sales Representitive.
description:
Carrier Sales Representative



Location:  Remote 

Job Type: Full-Time

Department: Operations / Carrier Sales



About Us



We are a fast-growing freight brokerage dedicated to providing reliable transportation solutions and exceptional customer service. We connect shippers with trusted carrier partners across North America, leveraging industry expertise, technology, and strong relationships to deliver results. We are seeking a motivated and energetic Carrier Sales Representative to join our team and help drive capacity solutions for our customers.



Position Summary



The Carrier Sales Representative is responsible for developing and managing relationships with trucking companies, securing capacity for customer freight, and ensuring successful load execution. This role requires strong negotiation skills, attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.





Key Responsibilities



-Source, negotiate, and secure transportation capacity for customer shipments.

-Build and maintain relationships with carrier partners across multiple modes of transportation.

-Negotiate rates while balancing profitability and service expectations.

-Track and manage shipments from pickup through delivery, proactively addressing any service issues.

-Monitor market conditions and carrier availability to provide competitive transportation solutions.

-Communicate effectively with carriers, customers, and internal teams regarding shipment status and updates.

-Identify and onboard new carrier partners while ensuring compliance with company and industry standards.

-Maintain accurate records within the transportation management system (TMS).

-Meet or exceed individual and team performance goals.



Qualifications Required



*Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

*Ability to multitask and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment.

*Proficiency with Microsoft Office and general computer applications.

*Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.





Preferred

*Intermediate or fluent in English is a real big plus

*1+ years of experience in freight brokerage, carrier sales, logistics, transportation, or a related field.

*Experience using transportation management systems (TMS) and load boards.

*Knowledge of truckload, LTL, and transportation market dynamics.





What We Offer



*Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission opportunities.

*Paid time off and company holidays.

*Career growth and advancement opportunities.

*Ongoing training and professional development.

*Collaborative and high-energy team environment.



Success in This Role



Top performers in this position are highly motivated, competitive, relationship-driven professionals who excel at building carrier networks, negotiating favorable rates, and ensuring freight moves efficiently and on time.



Ready to join our team? Apply today and help us deliver exceptional transportation solutions across North America





Some general questions: 



On a scale of 1 to 10(10 being the highest) how would you rate your speaking and reading level in English?

How many years of expereince do you have in logistics?

Have you ever worked at a freight brokerage or with a carrier company?

Do you have experience coordinating shipments?

Do you have any experience in tracking and tracing freight shipments?

description:

About Us

We are a growing pet product brand dedicated to making life better for dogs and their humans. We believe our community is the heart of our brand, and we are looking for a creative, proactive storyteller to bring our brand voice to life, elevate our aesthetic, and cultivate a deeply connected community of pet lovers.



The Role

As our Social Media & Community Manager, you won’t just be scheduling posts—you will be the face, voice, and heart of our daily brand presence. We are looking for someone who treats our social channels like a vibrant, welcoming community hub. If you have an eye for design, a passion for authentic engagement, and the drive to bring fresh ideas to the table, we want to hear from you.



Key Responsibilities

Creative Content & Aesthetic Curation: Design, shoot, and curate visually stunning, on-brand content (photos, reels/TikToks, stories, and graphics) that elevates our brand aesthetic and resonates with dog owners.



Active Community Engagement: Act as the "real person" behind the page. Responsively monitor and reply to comments, DMs, and questions, ensuring our audience feels heard, valued, and connected in real time.



Drive Organic Growth & Initiative: Don't just follow a content calendar—help build it. We want someone who proactively pitches and executes creative campaigns, interactive polls, and community-building ideas.



User-Generated Content (UGC) Management: Build relationships with our customers and their pups, encouraging, organizing, and celebrating user-generated content.



Launch Recurring Features: Take ownership of community-centric segments—like launching a “Pup of the Week” feature to showcase our customers’ dogs and tell their unique stories to drive deeper engagement.



What We’re Looking For

A Stellar Creative Eye: You have a strong sense of visual aesthetics, branding, and what makes content scroll-stopping.



High Responsiveness & Empathy: You genuinely enjoy chatting with people online. You understand that quick, warm, and helpful responses build lasting customer loyalty.



High Initiative & Autonomy: You are a self-starter who doesn't wait for instructions to innovate. You naturally look for ways to make things more engaging and love seeing your ideas come to life.



Platform Expertise: Deep knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, and other relevant social platforms, including current trends, audio, and algorithm shifts.



A Passion for Pets: A genuine love for dogs and understanding the pet-parent community is a massive plus!



Why You’ll Love Working With Us

- Flexible remote work environment

- Opportunity to take true ownership of a brand’s creative direction and watch your ideas make a direct impact.

- An endless stream of cute dog photos to work with every single day.

Please send your resume along with a link to your portfolio or social media accounts you've managed. In your application, please include one brief idea for a creative, recurring social media segment you think would help build a community around a pet brand!

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive, friendly, and detail-oriented Guest Services Virtual Assistant to join our remote team. This role has a strong focus on telephone-based customer service and guest support. You will be one of the first points of contact for our guests and operational teams, answering calls, resolving queries, and ensuring a high level of service is delivered at all times.

You will also support our UK-based team with general administration tasks, guest communications, and assisting our cleaning teams with day-to-day queries. This is a fast-paced and varied role where excellent communication skills, professionalism, and problem-solving abilities are essential.

Guest Communication & Telephone Support

Answer incoming calls from guests in a professional, friendly, and confident manner.

, WhatsApp, and other communication channels.

Escalate urgent matters to the appropriate UK team members when required.

Guest Issue Resolution

Assist with troubleshooting common guest issues, including heating, hot tubs, Wi-Fi, access information, and general property queries.

Keep guests updated throughout the resolution process and ensure issues are followed through to completion.

Help coordinate guest arrivals, departures, changeovers, and any issues identified at properties.

Support cleaners with accessing information and escalating maintenance concerns where necessary.

Reviews & Feedback Management

Monitor, analyse, and respond to guest reviews on platforms such as Airbnb, Booking.com, and Google Reviews.

Identify recurring feedback themes and suggest opportunities for service improvements.

Reservations & Administration

Verify that reservations are fully paid and follow up on any outstanding payments where required.

Check bookings and ensure guest information is accurate and complete.

Update internal systems, spreadsheets, and property information.

Assist with compiling and updating property guides, welcome packs, and other guest-facing materials.

Support the UK team with general administrative tasks and ad hoc projects.



About You

We are looking for someone who is:

Fluent in spoken and written English with a clear and professional telephone manner.

Confident answering and handling a high volume of telephone calls.

Friendly, personable, and able to build rapport with guests and colleagues.

Experienced in customer service, hospitality, travel, or holiday rentals (preferred).

Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities.

A strong problem-solver who remains calm under pressure.

Tech-savvy and comfortable using booking platforms, spreadsheets, and communication tools.

Proactive, adaptable, and able to work independently whilst remaining a supportive team player.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same.



Benefits

Fully remote position.

Opportunity to work with a growing and ambitious holiday rental company.

Friendly, collaborative, and supportive team environment.

Varied and interesting role with genuine responsibility.

Ongoing training and development opportunities.

Potential for career progression as the company continues to grow.



Working Hours (Philippine Time)

Current Philippine Hours (BST):

Tuesday: 7:00 pm – 3:00 am (Wednesday)

Wednesday: 7:00 pm – 3:00 am (Thursday)

Thursday: 7:00 pm – 3:00 am (Friday)

Friday: 7:00 pm – 3:00 am (Saturday)

Please note: As the UK observes daylight saving time, Philippine working hours will adjust by one hour when the UK changes between British Summer Time (BST) and Greenwich Mean Time (GMT). Applicants must be flexible and comfortable working evening and overnight shifts in the Philippines.



Applicants must have:

A reliable internet connection and suitable home working setup.

A quiet workspace suitable for taking telephone calls.

A professional telephone manner and excellent spoken English.

The ability to work independently and confidently handle guest and operational calls.

title: 3D Architectural Visualization Artist (Exterior + Interior + Animation + Vr tours, Photoreal)

About us

Iterate quickly on feedback. We art-direct the final look; you own the production.

Hit deadlines without us having to chase you.

Excellent control of lighting, materials, and composition. This is what separates you from the average artist.

The ability to match a detailed visual reference precisely. We give you mood boards and real project photos; your job is to hit that target, not improvise your own style.

Strong, reliable English communication.

Self-managing. You plan your own time and flag problems early.

Post-production skills (Photoshop).

Animation / flythrough or real-time experience (D5, Lumion, Unreal).

 marketing into a serious revenue channel — not just a newsletter, but a full retention machine that drives lifetime value, repeat purchases, and subscriptions.

We use Klaviyo. We need someone who lives in Klaviyo.



The Role



You own
. The flows, the campaigns, the segments, the copy, the design, the testing, the data. This isn't a role where we tell you what to send — we need someone who builds the strategy, executes it, and reports on what's working. You'll work closely with our Creative Strategist on visual direction, but the
 domain is yours.

Our goal is simple:
 should drive 30%+ of total revenue. If you've done that before, we want to talk.



What You'll Do



? Build, optimise, and manage all Klaviyo
 flows from scratch — welcome series, abandoned cart, abandoned browse, post-purchase, win-back, sunset, VIP, replenishment, subscription nudge, review request

? Write high-converting
 copy — direct response style, not corporate newsletter. You understand pain points, urgency, social proof, and how to make someone click "buy" from an

 templates — clean, on-brand, mobile-first. If you can design in Klaviyo or Canva yourself, even better. If not, you brief our designer with precision

? Plan and execute weekly/bi-weekly campaign sends — promotions, content, education, launches, seasonal

? Build and maintain smart segmentation — by purchase behavior, engagement level, product interest, lifecycle stage, subscription status. No batch-and-blast

? A/B test everything — subject lines, send times, copy, design, offers, flow timing. You test with structure, not gut feeling

? Monitor deliverability — inbox placement, spam rates, list hygiene, domain reputation. You keep us out of the promotions tab

? Analyze and report on
 performance — revenue attribution, flow performance, campaign ROI, list growth, churn. Weekly report to the founders

? Focus on LTV and subscriptions — our biggest lever is turning first-time buyers into subscribers. Your flows and campaigns should be engineered to drive recurring revenue

? Build a replenishment strategy — supplements run out. You know when. You
 at the right time with the right message

? Coordinate with our Creative Strategist to ensure
 creative is congruent with ads and landing pages



What You Won't Do



? Run ads — separate team

? Build landing pages — separate workflow

? Customer support — separate team

? Guess — everything you do is backed by data or a structured test



What We're Looking For



? Deep Klaviyo expertise — you've built flows from scratch, not just tweaked templates. You know the platform inside out: flow filters, conditional splits, dynamic content, custom properties, API events

? DTC e-commerce
 experience — ideally supplements, beauty, wellness, or health. You understand the buying psychology in this space

? Direct response copywriting skills — your
s read like a good sales page, not a corporate memo. You write hooks, you build urgency, you close

? Data-driven — you can pull a Klaviyo report and tell us exactly where the revenue is leaking and what to fix

? Experience with subscription models — you've worked with brands that sell subscriptions or replenishment products and you know how to use
 to drive and retain subscribers

? Experience building segments that actually drive results — not just "engaged vs. unengaged" but sophisticated behavioral segments that change how you communicate

? Deliverability knowledge — you understand SPF, DKIM, DMARC, warm-up schedules, list cleaning, and why engagement-based sending matters



How You Work (This Matters as Much as Your Skills)



? You build systems, not just
s. Your flow architecture, your testing calendar, your segmentation logic, your reporting cadence — all of it is documented and repeatable

? You create SOPs for everything you build. If you set up a flow, there's a document that explains the logic, the triggers, the timing, and the reason behind every decision

? You organise your work so that someone could take over your
 program and understand exactly what's running, why, and what's next

? You take full ownership — you don't wait for us to tell you what to send. You look at the data, see the opportunity, propose the test, and execute

? You report proactively — every week we know what's performing, what's underperforming, and what you're doing about it

? You think about
 as part of the full customer journey, not an isolated channel. How does the
 experience connect to the ad they clicked, the landing page they saw, and the product they received?

?
 revenue grows from current levels to 30%+ of total revenue within 90 days

? All core flows are live, tested, and optimised within 30 days

? Subscription conversion rate from
 increases measurably within 60 days

? Weekly reporting cadence established and maintained

? Full SOP documentation for every flow and process within 60 days

? List health metrics stay strong: deliverability above 95%, unsubscribe rate below 0.3%

Share a Klaviyo flow you built from scratch. Walk us through the logic: what triggers it, how many
s, what are the conditional splits, and what results did it drive?



A DTC supplement brand has a 12% repeat purchase rate and no subscription program yet. How would you use
 to increase that? Be specific about which flows and campaigns you'd build.

? Walk us through from blank page to final send — including how you decide on the angle, subject line, and CTA.

 4. What do you do?



Have you built SOPs or documentation for an
 program before? Describe what you documented and why.



What's your weekly reporting structure? What metrics do you report on and what do you do with the insights?



Details



? Remote, ongoing contract

 marketing and subscription-based brands

title: CRM & Hubspot Specialist
description:
About Us

Strategic Axis is a leading training and professional development provider, delivering corporate training, certifications, and learning solutions that help professionals and organizations grow, adapt, and succeed.



What are we looking for?

We are looking for a data-driven CRM & HubSpot Specialist to take full ownership of our HubSpot ecosystem. In this role, you will be the bridge between marketing, sales, and client success, ensuring our portal is optimized, our data is clean, and our automation is driving measurable growth.

The ideal candidate isn't just a "user"—you are an architect who understands how to build scalable workflows and turn raw data into actionable insights.



Key Responsibilities

-Platform Architecture: Design and maintain the technical structure of HubSpot (CRM, Sales, Marketing, and Service Hubs) to support business goals.

-Automation & Workflows: Build and manage sophisticated automation for lead scoring, nurturing, internal notifications, and client onboarding.

-Data Integrity: Implement strict data governance protocols to ensure hygiene, manage deduplication, and maintain accurate property mapping.

-Reporting & Analytics: Develop custom dashboards and advanced reports to track KPIs (e.g., MQL-to-SQL conversion, pipeline velocity, and ROI).

-Integration Management: Oversee integrations between HubSpot and third-party tools (e.g., LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Gmail/Outlook, and Slack).

-Lead Lifecycle Strategy: Define and manage lead stages (Subscriber, Lead, MQL, SQL, Opportunity) to ensure a clear path from first touch to closed-won.

-Lead Scoring Model: Develop and refine predictive lead scoring based on behavioral data 
 opens, website visits) and firmographic fit to prioritize high-value prospects.

-Campaign Execution: Build and deploy marketing assets within HubSpot, including landing pages, tracking URLs (UTMs), and automated
 drip campaigns.

-Lead Routing: Design and monitor automated "round-robin" or territory-based lead assignment rules to ensure sales follow up with MQLs within established SLAs.

-Database Segmentation: Create dynamic active lists for targeted marketing based on industry, persona, and engagement level to increase conversion rates.

-Attribution Reporting: Manage multi-touch attribution reports to identify which marketing channels and campaigns are generating the highest quality leads.

-Team Enablement: Act as the internal "HubSpot Guru," providing training and documentation to ensure high adoption across all departments.

-Newsletter Strategy & Execution: End-to-end management of our recurring newsletters. This includes content curation, layout design, and scheduling.


 Marketing Optimization: Conduct A/B testing on subject lines, CTAs, and send times to maximize open rates and engagement.

-Content Distribution: Repurpose high-performing newsletter content for LinkedIn posts and lead magnets to drive top-of-funnel growth.

-Nurture Sequences: Design automated "Welcome" and "Re-engagement"
 sequences that keep our brand top of mind for cold or dormant leads.

-Subscriber Growth: Implement on-site pop-ups, slide-ins, and gated content strategies to consistently grow the newsletter subscriber base.

-Brand Consistency: Ensure all outbound marketing communications align with our brand voice, especially when targeting HR professionals and C-suite stakeholders.



### Core Responsibilities: The Marketing Engine

-Full-Funnel Marketing Strategy: Develop and execute multi-channel marketing plans 
, LinkedIn, Content) designed to attract, engage, and delight B2B clients.

-Content & Newsletter Management: Lead the editorial calendar for our recurring newsletters. You will handle everything from subject line copywriting to layout design and performance analysis.

-Lead Generation & Management: Build and optimize lead capture forms, landing pages, and automated "lead magnets" to convert website traffic into actionable leads.

-LinkedIn & Social Integration: Manage corporate LinkedIn presence and lead generation efforts, ensuring brand consistency across all digital touchpoints.

-Brand Voice & Copywriting: Act as the "editor-in-chief" for all outbound communications, ensuring a professional, insightful, and supportive tone—specifically when targeting HR Directors and C-Suite executives.

-Event & Program Support: Assist in the digital promotion of corporate events (e.g., wellness workshops, webinars, or CSR initiatives) through automated invite sequences and follow-up workflows.



### Technical Requirements

HubSpot Mastery: Expert-level knowledge of the Marketing Hub (Workflows, Sequences, and Lead Flows).

Funnel Optimization: Proven track record of reducing funnel friction and improving MQL-to-SQL conversion rates.

Inbound Knowledge: Strong understanding of inbound marketing methodologies and content-led lead generation.



### Qualifications & Skills

-Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience managing HubSpot in a B2B environment.

-Certifications: Active HubSpot Certifications (Marketing, Sales, and Reporting) are highly preferred.

-Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of custom objects, API integrations, and advanced workflow logic.

-Analytical Mindset: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and the ability to interpret complex data sets.

-Communication: Ability to translate technical CRM requirements into plain language for non-technical stakeholders.

-Detail-Oriented: A "zero-mistake" approach to data management and
 automation.



### Performance Indicators (KPIs)

-Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs): Volume and quality of leads generated.

-Conversion Rate: Percentage of leads moving through each funnel stage.

-Sales Feedback Loop: Consistency and speed of lead follow-up by the sales team.

-Database Health: Percentage of "marketable" contacts and bounce rate management.



### Why Join Us?

This is a pivotal role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital infrastructure. You will work in a fast-paced environment where your work directly impacts revenue and the efficiency of the entire team
